scientific_role: E0-design teacher-forced mechanism audit and centered-lambda operator sweep

teacher_forcing.response_metric: sum eligible-token gold_logp within each complete assistant response, average member samples within content group, then average distinct content groups
teacher_forcing.end_task_accuracy: deterministic E0-compatible generated-answer correctness, counted once per distinct content group; never teacher-forced next-token accuracy

centered_lambda.prior_mean: Kbar_i = sum_j A_ij K_ij; Vbar_i = sum_j A_ij V_ij
centered_lambda.global_denominator: all valid ordinary native atoms and all legal transported child atoms share one global attention softmax denominator
centered_lambda.lambda_zero_contract: lambda=0 factorized global attention is C_post exactly, including when ordinary native atoms share the same global denominator, because all child atoms equal their prior mean and sum_j A_ij=1
centered_lambda.lambda_one_contract: lambda=1 is the unmodified F operator
centered_lambda.selection_role: E0-design root-cause localization only; it cannot establish E1-pilot performance

topology_decision_contract.partition_compositional: the frozen sanitizer certifies the row and all positive-length candidate intersections form a source-index-unique, monotone, pairwise-disjoint complete cover of the receiver span
topology_decision_contract.competing_overlap: every candidate independently covers the complete receiver span; source indices and token IDs are unique; source spans are distinct; and zero-length, duplicate-offset, partial-overlap, receiver-overlap, boundary, fallback, and window-neighbor aliases are absent
topology_decision_contract.boundary_fallback: boundary/fallback geometry, a zero-length interval, duplicate/overlapping receiver offsets, duplicate source offsets, partial-overlap source alias, missing receiver intersection, malformed geometry, or special-token fallback is explicitly present
topology_decision_contract.neighbor_expansion: at least one candidate origin is explicitly window_neighbor and no higher-precedence boundary/fallback condition is present
topology_decision_contract.taxonomy_unresolved: m>=2 geometry that satisfies none of the frozen positive rules; ordinary soft-span partial coverage, multiple overlaps, or failure of the partition rule alone is never evidence of competition

raw_topology_audit.grain: task x sample x raw pre-sanitizer parent with m>=2
raw_topology_audit.span_frame: receiver_span and candidate source_span/intersection are clipped message-content-relative character intervals; absolute tokenizer offsets are retained separately
raw_topology_audit.runtime_collapse_contract: offset-uncertified raw m>=2 rows retain at most one deterministic runtime candidate in every operator arm
raw_topology_audit.functional_metric_contract: raw and offset-uncertified topology rows contain no checkpoint/model/query functional metric; only certified runtime m>=2 rows may appear in the separate functional mechanism table
raw_topology_audit.aggregate_contract: report raw/runtime m, raw-minus-runtime candidate and extra-slot deltas, and taxonomy parent/sample/distinct-content-group counts for every task
raw_topology_audit.serialization_contract: JSONL is written row-wise and Parquet in fixed 4096-row batches; only raw m>=2 topology rows are serialized and no raw KV/logit tensor is retained

input_row.grain: seed x checkpoint arm x inference operator x task x sample x answer query x layer x query head x parent x lambda
input_row.array_contract: prior and gamma contain exactly candidate_count finite nonnegative values and each sums to one when candidate_count > 0
input_row.candidate_contract: functional rows contain certified runtime parents only, so 2 <= candidate_count <= 4
input_row.head_contract: query_head is Hq; kv_head=floor(query_head/(Hq/Hkv)); source/fused D and energy are full head-by-feature Frobenius scalars repeated over query heads because sender and receiver heads have no semantic one-to-one map
input_row.baseline_join: cpost fields are mechanically joined by the executor on seed/checkpoint arm/task/sample/query/target/target_token_id plus input/alignment/labels hashes; a runtime backend may not self-report them

derived_metrics.gamma_query_variance: mean_j Var over distinct eligible answer query positions of gamma_tij
derived_metrics.posterior_top1_changed: posterior argmax differs across eligible answer query positions
derived_metrics.response_delta_gold_logp: sum of delta_gold_logp over all eligible answer queries in a complete assistant response

bounded_streaming_execution.stage_input: one deterministic merged Parquet whose shard blocks are ordered by canonical shard_id and whose rows are strictly frozen-row-key ordered within each shard
bounded_streaming_execution.reader: ParquetFile.iter_batches with 4096 rows per batch; no whole-file read_table/to_pylist/read_text materialization
bounded_streaming_execution.detail_output: bounded partition fragments followed by deterministic k-way merge into 4096-row Parquet row groups
bounded_streaming_execution.aggregate_output: per-sample bounded reductions are combined in deterministic sample order; parent geometry consistency is enforced by a disk-backed unique index
bounded_streaming_execution.verification: re-read only input columns from frozen detail Parquet, independently rerun the same bounded derivation, and require byte-size plus SHA256 equality for every formal artifact
bounded_streaming_execution.spill_contract: temporary local spill only; removed on success or failure; no raw KV, logits, predictions, model, or checkpoint object is retained

e1_layer_head_summary.csv.role: equal-row mechanism decomposition by layer and head

e1_raw_topology_ledger.jsonl.role: local model-output-free, row-replayable raw-to-runtime geometry ledger from the frozen input-lock sidecar

e1_raw_topology_ledger.parquet.role: columnar duplicate of the local raw topology ledger

e1_raw_topology_aggregates.csv.role: task x taxonomy x raw-m x runtime-m parent/sample/group counts and raw/runtime candidate deltas

e1_raw_topology_aggregates.json.role: task-level raw/runtime m distributions, taxonomy counts, and no-functional-metric integrity statement

e1_raw_topology_manifest.json.role: hash, byte-size, row-count, source-sidecar provenance, and claim-boundary manifest for all raw topology artifacts

claim_boundary: Candidate count or dispersion proves structural opportunity only.
A nonzero centered-lambda response on E0-design identifies headroom but is not an E1-pilot performance result.
No E1-pilot, model-selection, or test output may be consumed by this protocol.
